Under Rasoi Steel Works' quality and regulatory compliance policies, any supplier providing materials that touch food must have a valid, active **food-grade certificate**. 

Even if their pricing is lower, orders for food-contact items cannot be placed with uncertified suppliers. If the supplier is willing to undergo testing and obtain an approved food-grade certificate, we can review and update their profile in Bahi once certified.
